create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance that writes output to both terminal and a log file
write_log_message: write a message to the Logger which outputs to both stdout and the log file
init_logger_append_mode: initialize a Logger in append mode to preserve existing log file contents
init_logger_write_mode: initialize a Logger in write mode that overwrites any existing log file
review_logger_class: review the Logger class that duplicates stdout to a file with automatic directory creation
